resources.string: Read the Bible at your own pace, without pressure.

Life is unpredictable. Some days you will read. Other days you won't — and that's okay.

Rema is not here to judge you. There are no "lost" days, no delay counters, no guilt.

Every time you come back, the app adapts to you. You choose your pace. You stay in control.

Let's begin.
How would you like to read?
No plan, no pressure — read what you want, when you want.
In the historical order of events
Perfect. Read at your own pace.
You will navigate freely between books and chapters.

« For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life. For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved. He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God. »

Keep your progress on every device
One notification per day — only to remind you to read. Never marketing.
